finding: The pre-optimization hydration topology performs one evidence read and one metadata read per candidate when providers expose only point APIs. The opt-in bulk capability can reduce backend operations while preserving the same canonical validation path.
limitations: This is a deterministic operation-count profile, not a real database/model latency or throughput benchmark. It does not authorize a production speedup claim.
production_action: Keep baseline-v1 selected until comparable real-runtime holdout latency/resource evidence is available.
